observations: Before this change, CI Security supplied the scan command through an inline docker invocation; the image supplied tools only.
The entrypoint packages the collector and shared shell library in the image, mounts source read-only, and writes only the declared evidence directory.

CI explicitly invokes the runner with bash so the already-pinned tools-only image remains compatible; when a newly released scanner-image digest is promoted, the same runner selects its packaged collector.
